parks.name: Cape Cod National Seashore
parks.blurb: Dunes, beaches and ponds; gray seals, piping plovers, whales offshore and terns.

parks.name: Parker River National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Plum Island barrier beach and marsh; snowy owls, plovers, ducks and egrets.

parks.name: Monomoy National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Sandy islands off Cape Cod; gray seals, shorebirds, terns and sharks offshore.

parks.name: Great Meadows National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: River marsh in Concord; herons, turtles, muskrats and ducks.

parks.name: Mount Greylock State Reservation
parks.blurb: Highest peak in the state; black bears, moose, hawks and warblers.

parks.name: Wellfleet Bay Wildlife Sanctuary
parks.blurb: Salt marsh and beach; diamondback terrapins, horseshoe crabs, ospreys and seals.

parks.name: Blue Hills Reservation
parks.blurb: Forested hills near Boston; deer, coyotes, hawks and turtles.

parks.name: Drumlin Farm Wildlife Sanctuary
parks.blurb: Farm and woods in Lincoln; owls, hawks, foxes and farm animals.

parks.name: Arnold Arboretum
parks.blurb: Boston tree garden; red-tailed hawks, owls, chipmunks and squirrels.

parks.name: Halibut Point State Park
parks.blurb: Granite quarry and rocky shore; eiders, gulls, seals and tidepool crabs.

parks.name: October Mountain State Forest
parks.blurb: Largest state forest; moose, black bears, bobcats and wild turkeys.
